steps.text: Chernobog Central District 1:20 P.M.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Raidian, this is Kal'tsit. We're on the edge of the central district, four hundred and ten meters out from the warehouse, seventeen, sixty-seven, southwest.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Are you in position? Is the operation going according to plan?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: 'Unimpeded?'

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The situation on the ground seems to be in line with our expectations.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Reunion has deployed the guerrilla fighters at hubs throughout the core city, and stationed Reunion regulars or Sarkaz mercenaries elsewhere.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It would be unwise to spread their defenses thinly across the entire map. They will gather their elites in a few key locations. That's what I would do if I were leading Reunion.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Dr. Kal'tsit!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I know you want to speak to Raidian, Amiya. Patience.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: I... I do too...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...We're on a mission. Next time, okay?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Oh, um... okay.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Raidian, I have Amiya here for you.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Right!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Raidian, this is Amiya.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: (Well... You saw how Amiya and Rosmontis reacted.)

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: (Our younger personnel love Raidian. But she may be a little too warm and friendly for adults.)

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: (The adolescents have the most trouble with her.)

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: (Their need to self-actualize tends to conflict with Raidian's persistent motherliness.)

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: (I generally avoid putting them in the same team. You should check the manual for such details when planning.)

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Right... I saw, Raidian, yes.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: That's correct. No, that's not a standard tactic for guerrilla fighters. It's more like... hm...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Yes! Like the Doctor said, Raidian, Reunion has mixed things up a bit, but you can still see the shadow of the Ursus military here.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: They've undergone strict military training... Yes, that's likely.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The core network of Reunion personnel could be Infected who have received Ursus military training.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: They're the only ones who could gather up such a large group of Infected.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's clear that this battle won't be an easy win for us.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Hm? No, I'm fine. Rosmontis and I, all the Rhodes Island operators... we all wanted to be here.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Uh huh, it's okay, Raidian, I have Dr. {@nickname} and Dr. Kal'tsit with me.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: All right, Amiya, it's time to begin.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Right. Okay, Raidian, it's up to you and Dr. Kal'tsit.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: First thing's first, we have to make good use of our comms.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Team R-4, activate your equipment.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Raidian, it will take Rosmontis ten minutes to cast her Arts. During that time, we cannot lose comms for even a split second, unless we determine that we have to disconnect.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Continued use of Originium Arts will cause you discomfort, and if the nausea becomes unbearable, you are to immediately take the supplement I formulated for you.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Moderate dizziness is a side effect. It won't harm your nervous system, but it will massively drain your strength.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Be careful not to overdose. After the first ten minutes, you can take intermittent breaks. Do not overexert yourself.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We're asking a lot of you, Raidian.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Rosmontis, all of the enemy's messages will be sent to your portable terminal via Raidian. Feel them, and log them.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Should their location change, you cannot lose them. Seize their feelings and log them again.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Reach out with your body, Rosmontis, and picture yourself roaming the city.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: I understand, Dr. Kal'tsit.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Amiya...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I know.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You have your work cut out for you. If anything anomalous happens, I will stop your casting. The instant you feel any pain, let me know.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Rosmontis... I'm going closer to you.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Yes, I'm ready too. I'm not scared. Amiya, don't be scared of me.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I won't. I'm not scared of Rosmontis. We won't be scared.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Amiya is stabilizing Rosmontis's emotions.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You may not want to look directly at them, Dr. {@nickname}. It is unwise for any but the most tragically afflicted warriors to look directly at the expansion of the essence of Rosmontis's Arts.

options: You can't mean our little bunny...?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I figured you'd realize it sooner.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Or that you already knew but hadn't indicated as much to me.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But yes, Dr. {@nickname}.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...Amiya's battles, both physical and mental, have been far beyond what any human being should have to endure.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Two, or maybe three would be okay. The more people to share the burden, the better.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Dr. {@nickname}, I'm not talking specifically about a memory or a battlefield experience. This refers to demands on both responsibility and physical ability.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: If you'd like, you could hold Amiya's hand to share that burden.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: No, not today, anyway. You and I have another urgent task.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We need to buy them precious time.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: A pharmaceutical company investigates the root cause of a problem, adapts to the environment, allocates functions appropriately, and looks for a breakthrough.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Our target is smaller and more precise than in a conventional battle. A small tactical assault team's work is closer to a surgery than it is to a firefight.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: What the warmongers can't do falls within our area of expertise.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Rhodes Island is going to take out the enemy command in the core city. All our objectives center on rooting out the cause of this disease.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But even if we excise the cancer, if the cause of the problem remains unknown to us, it will not be fundamentally solved.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Dr. {@nickname}, I do hope you will give this due consideration.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: —Who are our patients?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The normal Infected? The Ursus who were Infected? Reunion? Or this city?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: And where is the cause of this disease?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We've discussed how Reunion is not maintaining the city's communication networks.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It has become clear that Talulah deliberately kept Originium clusters from the Catastrophe in the city to maintain a state of chaos.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: That will massively disrupt our communications.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Even our most advanced equipment will not function under these conditions.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But now, thanks to elite operator Raidian, we can make use of the otherwise chaotic airwaves.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: That leaves us with a direct, reliable method of communication, and a tactical advantage.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: True.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You saw the runners carrying megaphones. The guerrillas use these antiquated methods to carry intelligence and orders in encrypted messages.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We have yet to properly map the movements of these runners, but Rosmontis is working on it.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Their transmissions may not be instantaneous, and are limited in range, but it is the most stable and disciplined method in a hostile environment.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Can you guess what's wrong with this method?

options: It depends on the person first giving the order?
The squad can't survive without its head.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Correct.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The real commander's location is hidden.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: What would you do in that position, Doctor?

options: I'd have to cause some chaos first.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Correct.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Now we've focused our thinking. This is another tactical advantage.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Doctor, the Arts Rosmontis is releasing will show us the location of every runner and their patrol routes.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: She will expand her consciousness and capture every physical structure within range. At the same time, her mental state will grow increasingly chaotic.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Amiya is working to flatten those emotions.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Raidian is the core of our communications. With her Arts, we can communicate unimpeded for a short period of time.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We just need to wait for Rosmontis to finish her part, then we go.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: For now, the guerrillas know nothing about us.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: They are completely unaware that we are targeting their communications, or that we are able to work against the ancient Sarkaz witchcraft..

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We do have our methods, limited as they may be.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: After striking the runners, the guerrillas will respond. Within a half hour, they will have new runners working, and they will be hardened against further attacks.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: They will be on high alert, and may not have weaknesses to exploit.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: What's more, we will have exposed our positioning and tactics, putting us in a difficult situation.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: However, we only need to execute a single surgical strike. With that one blow, we will force out their command unit.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The guerrillas won't be expecting another Infected spec ops team.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: This is a tactical advantage.

options: I'm more concerned with implementation. Will it work?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: —I'm not going to exaggerate.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Dr. {@nickname}, even with our three tactical advantages, we are more likely to fail than succeed.

options: Then why do it like this?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Because anything else would be even less likely to succeed.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...Rosmontis should have started her search. Hold your breath, and don't look.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: —First—

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: I... found three.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Rosmontis... you're okay. Come here, a little closer.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: ...Four.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Your ear. I'm running my finger over your ear like this... you can hear it. These are just fragments of your imagination, and you've seen it all before.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Mm...

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Five.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Doctor, are you afraid of getting hurt?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: These three teams will split up for the fight. Each will be responsible for enemy teams and crippling the runners in a different sector. We cannot give them a chance to get the word out.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Each of our squads will also redistribute their power projection, which I have already planned for. Don't worry.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: As for you, you're with me.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Bring your security specialist. You can't refuse. I think.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The guerrillas' equipment is of excellent quality, similar to that of the Ursus military, and they keep to discipline and tactics even more harshly and effectively.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Sarkaz, Ursus, Liberi and other races all united under a single banner.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You are safe only under my protection. I don't want Rosmontis to kill you by accident, and I don't want Amiya to distract herself trying to protect you. And Raidian, you haven't even met.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You can't cause trouble with me.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...Wait.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: —Rosmontis?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Ah... Nng...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Raidian, sever Rosmontis's connection. Now!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Amiya, her mental state?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But... Rosmontis... The scene I reached out to was stable, nothing strange was happening... It shouldn't have...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's... falling? She's... looking at the sky?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...Lost. She's lost. She's falling.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Body temperature dropping, shortness of breath... Sharp decrease in endorphin levels.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: (Shakes her head)

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: This isn't like Raidian using supplements to replenish her energy. Rosmontis's Arts throw off a balance inside her body, but not an entirely biological one.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Injecting steroids to increase hormone production can seriously disrupt her endocrine system that could result in a failure of her inhibitor functions.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: You left me? Why... I have to...

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: —Why did you leave me...?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Bad is not an excuse to indulge my incompetence.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Dr. {@nickname}, I will not resort to emergency measures that cause permanent bodily harm... no matter how effective they may be.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Rosmontis's problem is not biological. She is the only one who can solve it.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Rosmontis.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Rosmontis, look at my hand.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Doc... tor... Kal... tsit..

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Look at Dr. Kal'tsit's hand.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: My hand is stroking your face now. Look, Dr. Kal'tsit is here. Look at me.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: ...Hnng.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Rosmontis, Kal'tsit doesn't have much time to stay with you. Neither does Amiya...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Outcast, Misery, Blaze, or anyone else.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But for now, Amiya and I are here.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Uh... huh.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Keep pushing, Rosmontis. Walk forward.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Yes, Rosmontis... over here. Walk this way. On the deck.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's very hard, I know... But, Rosmontis, this is the deck, you can step on it. You won't fall through.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: This is Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We're here with you.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'm here with you.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: —I know.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: ...Doctor... Kal'tsit... give me...

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: The... data.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: —Okay.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Raidian, connect Rosmontis's terminal. She's okay.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I'm sure. Do it.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: —Second.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Seven.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I see..

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Her... Rosmontis is standing now. Her consciousness is peaceful and harmonious. Aw... it's like a fluffy basket holding her dreams.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We're fine, Dr. Kal'tsit.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Pfft.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Amiya's turning red, Dr. {@nickname}.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...I didn't want you to see that!

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: It's okay. Mmhm. Okay.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Again... again. Amiya, let's go forward a bit. I can feel it.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Third.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: ...Dr. Kal'tsit, I found them. All of them.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We're ready.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Yes, thank you. And thank you, Amiya.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Don't thank me for doing my job, Rosmontis... no need. You know I love saying that, don't you?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Uh huh. But you took me to the bridge, and to the mountain... and the clouds were so pretty.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: It's a long road.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Let's go, Amiya. We can go down.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Raidian, split the connections. You can take five.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Amiya, Rosmontis, keep the channel clear.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Okay, now, Raidian, Dr. Kal'tsit, Rosmontis...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Time to fight.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It looks like you have something on your mind.

options: Your tone is much softer than it used to be.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: That's not what you're thinking. But if you'd like, I can be harsher with you.

options: I want to talk about the silver-haired girl.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You were very lucky back there.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Taking a step back, it may be that Rosmontis likes you. She controlled her outburst.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Otherwise you would have bitten off your own tongue watching Amiya and I guide her, and seeing the manifestation of her Arts.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...Rosmontis was born in a lab.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: She did not suffer the same tragedy as most experimental Infected. She did not die from the increasingly cruel experiments.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: As the project moved forward, she gradually crushed the entire facility.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The lab did not destroy her, she destroyed it. Her Arts are tied to her mental state.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The group that found her and smuggled her to Rhodes Island has made it clear that 'Rosmontis does not exist.'

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I know what you're thinking. And no, through force or coercion, I would never allow an individual who has been through that to become an operator.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But Rosmontis herself chose responsibility, training, and companionship.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: With her subconscious Arts usage causing constant damage, the caster operators decided to train her. She had to mature faster than the others, which she fortunately wanted to do.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We didn't want to abandon her to the wilderness. We did not want to inject her with suppressants. And we certainly didn't want Rhodes Island to be reduced to a heap of pulverized shrapnel.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: This solution was our last resort. We have to train her to use her Arts, rather than indulge or imprison her.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: She's like Amiya in some ways, and unlike her in others.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Then let me finish, please.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: They are alike in that they will both fight to the end for other people.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: As for how they're different—

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You know Amiya has never wanted to make enemies. Even when forced to do so, she fights back her tears, reluctantly destroying her enemies.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But Rosmontis, I could say, Doctor, that Rosmontis...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: She's never given up on a mission. Faced with any situation, she handles it appropriate, and wins.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: That is our simultaneously reasonable and incomprehensible Annihilation Specialist, Rosmontis.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: She is an elite operator for no other reason than she met the standards across the entire battery of tests.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The operators who feared her came to know what she was really like and ultimately put their lives in her hands...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Because she protects them, with all her power.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: If Blaze won the respect of our people through leadership of her team, Rosmontis fought for their respect.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: She heard their expectations, and exceeded them.

options: But there are practical considerations to her participation here.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: There are other operators with detection Arts similar to Rosmontis's, with different casting conditions.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Rosmontis can do more than just locate, you've seen the way she fights.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Dr. {@nickname}, we allowed Rosmontis to join this op because she is the best operator for the job, and because she believes as much herself.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Her Arts are also enough to help Amiya and I face the leader of the guerrillas...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: 'Patriot, of Reunion.'

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Dr. Kal'tsit! The abandoned trolley station, behind the fallen restaurant sign, the gate of #4 Secondary School, third floor of the town hall clocktower!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Acknowledged.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Copy! I'll go to the town hall, Dr. Kal'tsit!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Then we'll go to #4 Secondary School, Doctor. Move.

options: I'll help you command, Dr. Kal'tsit.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Precisely.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Rosmontis, Amiya, and I will deal with the runners. And you...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Dr. {@nickname}, you will command our free units and slow the guerrilla fighters.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Remember, we target only the enemies we can target.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Once the guerrillas regroup, we fall back. We are here to complete our objective, not to entertain some fantastical idea of a direct fight.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: This will be a protracted battle. We could suffer casualties, or even total defeat.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: If that happens, we could be facing a new dark age for the Infected.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The best possible outcome for us could be that the command squad does not appear.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We head straight for the command tower and the generator area, leaving the Reunion Infected to handle their own problems with the Infected.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But he won't, not this guerrilla commander.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: He won't lose control of the battle and watch his team fall apart. It is not faith alone that keeps his people together, he has the strength to live up to his name.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: After this battle, if all goes well... we will commit everything to a conflict with their command squad.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We will face down Buldrokkas'tee.
